records.text: Darkmaster Gandling presides over a deadly scholastic encounter in Scholomance. He announces, “School is in session!”

Vectus is an undead mage and Scourge scholar in Scholomance, where he studies black dragon eggs and oversees the training of young dragons. His instructions pair careful research with cruelty: he urges torture of a prisoner to entertain a dragon before its meal, and says the Scourge timetable must support the Lich King's plans. He expects students to wear their attire and study, and asks visitors whether they have brought eggs from the Burning Steppes.

Marduk Blackpool is a Scholomance figure who answers questions with ominous divinations. He senses disturbances, warns that a listener's mind is unfocused, and says the future is clouded; his suspicion extends to visitors who do not look like students. At a moment of betrayal, he cries, “We are betrayed!”
A Scholomance Adept is a hostile spellcaster who attacks with frost magic, including Frostbolt, Cone of Cold, and Frost Shock. When badly wounded, an Adept may flee for help.
A Scholomance Neophyte is a hostile spellcaster who uses Fear in combat.
A Scholomance acolyte that assumes Shadowform while out of combat.
A Scholomance occultist who protects itself with Bone Armor and counters spellcasting. In battle it can also hurl shadow bolts and drain mana.

A Scholomance student attending lessons under the master's watch. Students urge one another to listen quietly, keep up with assignments, and wear their student attire; one asks to share a textbook, while another speaks of trying to spawn a dragonflight.
A Scholomance necrolyte who attacks with Shadow Bolt.
A Scholomance necromancer who attacks with a volley of shadow bolts.
A splintered skeleton found in Scholomance. In combat it uses a spell that suppresses its hate toward its target.
An unstable undead corpse that erupts in a burst of disease when it dies, making its destruction hazardous to nearby foes.
A reanimated corpse that is restored to an invincible state when it resets, persisting as an undead threat until disturbed again.
A risen aberration that fixates on a target in combat, giving this misshapen undead a relentless focus during a fight.
A risen warrior among the undead ranks, striking opponents in combat with a direct melee attack.
A risen protector that guards the undead ranks with shadow magic, unleashing Shadow Shock against foes in combat.
A risen construct that can become enraged in combat and attack with Frenzy, a brute force threat among the undead.
A risen guard among the undead ranks, using Shield Slam against opponents in combat.
A risen bonewarder, an undead combatant, uses Bone Armor and Consuming Shadows in battle.
A diseased ghoul that casts Disease Cloud.
A spectral undead called a tutor, it silences enemies and projects an image when badly wounded.
A spectral researcher, an undead combatant that unleashes a Wail of Souls.
A spectral teacher, an undead combatant that casts Arcane Focus.
Lady Illucia Barov is a named undead combatant who uses fear, shadow magic, silence, and a curse of agony.
Jandice Barov is said to steward the blood of innocents from Krastinov to Kirtonos; she clutches a journal, loosening her grasp as she dies.
Lord Alexei Barov fights with Immolate and Veil of Shadows.
Instructor Malicia is found in Scholomance and harms nearby enemies with shadow magic and lingering corruption.
The Ravenian is undead and dwells in Scholomance, cleaving opponents and trampling nearby enemies.

Ras Frostwhisper is a lich in Scholomance whose mortal home was Stromgarde. Leonid Barthalomew recalls the human mage willingly pledging his soul to the Lich King and giving his life to become undead. Magistrate Marduke seeks a keepsake from Ras’s mortal life to reverse that transformation.
A young plagued dragon bred by Scourge necromancers at Scholomance, this hatchling attacks with diseased spit.
Lorekeeper Polkelt is an undead Scholomance combatant whose attacks include Volatile Infection, Corrosive Acid, and Noxious Catalyst.
A Scholomance handler who fights with Blast Wave.

Doctor Theolen Krastinov, called the Butcher, is a Scholomance surgeon who treats people as material for grotesque operations. He celebrates successful procedures and threatens victims with open-heart surgery; even as he dies, he speaks of donating his body to science.
A Necrofiend is an undead combatant in Scholomance that can cast Deadly Poison and Web Explosion.

Scholomance Dark Summoners instruct their class through examples of skeleton summoning, comparing the creatures’ frailty and combat usefulness. This summoner warns students away from brittle skeletons and explains that sturdier ones are a better choice.
Rattlegore is an undead combatant in Scholomance who uses Knock Away and War Stomp in combat.
Lord Blackwood is an undead who can cast Smoke Bomb, Shield Bash, Shoot and Black Arrow.
Blood Steward of Kirtonos is a creature encountered in the Plaguelands. It uses Evasion out of combat and casts Curse of Impotence in combat.

Elder Moonstrike speaks of the stars as beacons of hope and strength, and wonders whether the wise or fortunate can find earthly truths by looking to the heavens. His conversations also point visitors toward other named elders, including Darkcore, Graveborn and Highpeak.
